$description: Token proposals for ChatInput (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon covers it another way. Values are aliases to Carbon's own tokens where one exists.

background.$description: The composer's fill. Carbon's $chat-prompt-background is white in light, which holds. In dark it is the card's own fill, $layer-01, so the composer reads as the card with its rule. Interim until carbon-labs#1417 brings the v12 themes: then it returns to $layer-03, which in carbon#23376's v12 dark is #0c0d0f, the shell one step below the page, so FileChip ($layer-02) steps up from it. Under v11's g100, $layer-03 is #525252, a pill brighter than the card, which is why it is not that today. Falls back to $chat-prompt-background.

menu-hover.$description: A hovered row. The state ladder is counted in surface steps toward contrast from the token a control rests on: hover is one step, selected two. A row rests on the menu surface, so its hover is the blue-gray one step in — the same family as the selected tint, one rung below it, which is what keeps the two readable as the same ladder rather than two unrelated greys. Falls back to $layer-hover. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

menu-selected.$description: A selected row in the composer's menus. Carbon's Menu marks selection with a checkmark only; this adds the blue-gray tint at the selected step, the same value as MegaButton's selected fill so a selected control reads the same everywhere. The menus are inverse, so a light page shows the g100 value. Falls back to $layer-selected. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

menu-selected-text.$description: The label of a selected menu row: the brand blue solved for contrast on chat-input-menu-selected, the same value as MegaButton's selected text. Falls back to $text-primary. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule): a floating surface is already one step up, so its states are one step further. Resolved from the shared menu-* rungs, not picked by hand.

menu-active.$description: A row being pressed in the composer menus: the active rung on the blue-gray ladder, three steps from the menu surface and one past selected, so a press reads as the same ladder rather than Carbon's neutral between two tints. One step past hover would land on selected itself. Falls back to $layer-active. Counted from the surface the row rests on, which is the panel, not the page (the stacking rule). Resolved from the shared menu-active-fill, not picked by hand.
